purpose: provider-neutral statement of exactly what a future PIT provider must supply and prove before any scored stocks research may run. No provider is recommended, evaluated or endorsed here.

consumers.EQ_S2_A3_F1_PIT_RECON_FLOW: index maintenance events, PIT membership, survivorship-safe universe
consumers.A5-S2-F1-LENDING-CONSTRAINT-PREMIUM: borrow availability/fee/utilization, honest CA and accounting inputs
consumers.factory_shared: security master, identifiers, CA, prices, benchmark, calendar, checksums, license

rules: missing evidence is UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED, never inferred PASS
no purchase, account creation, credential request or unapproved download is authorized by this packet
a provider earns PASS only through the evidence column, evaluated in provider_evaluation_template.json and accepted via ingestion_acceptance_checklist.md

consuming_family_or_component: factory_shared (A3 data / A4 calendar+CA / A5 accounting-execution)
requirements.pit_clock: every attribute effective-dated; queries strictly as-of decision timestamp; no current-state backfill
requirements.minimum_coverage: full US common-stock + ETF universe for >= 8 calendar years before S0 end
requirements.rejection_condition: any as-of query returning current attributes; missing effective_from; unknown attribute provenance
requirements.evidence_needed_for_PASS: as-of replay spot-checks vs independent records; provider attestation of PIT maintenance

requirements.area: historical universe/index membership with effective timestamps
requirements.pit_clock: membership rows effective-dated; announcements and effective dates distinct events
requirements.minimum_coverage: >= 8y of membership history for the benchmark index(es) used by F1, incl. every add/delete event
requirements.rejection_condition: membership reconstructed from current index composition; missing add/delete events; backfilled starts
requirements.evidence_needed_for_PASS: event-level reconciliation vs published reconstitution archives on a sample of >= 5 years

consuming_family_or_component: factory_shared (A3 data / A4 calendar+CA / A5 accounting-execution)
requirements.pit_clock: effective-dated ticker/id map; resolution strictly as-of
requirements.minimum_coverage: full ticker-change history for all covered securities
requirements.rejection_condition: retired ticker resolving after change; new ticker resolving before; orphaned identifiers
requirements.evidence_needed_for_PASS: ticker-history table with effective ranges + reconciliation samples

consuming_family_or_component: factory_shared (A3 data / A4 calendar+CA / A5 accounting-execution)
requirements.pit_clock: listing/delisting dates effective-dated; delisted rows retained through last valid event
requirements.minimum_coverage: all listings/delistings incl. bankruptcies/mergers for covered universe across full history
requirements.rejection_condition: delisted securities dropped from history (survivorship); missing delist reason/effective date
requirements.evidence_needed_for_PASS: delisting census vs independent death records; retained-bars check to final valid event

requirements.area: splits, dividends and other corporate actions
consuming_family_or_component: factory_shared (A3 data / A4 calendar+CA / A5 accounting-execution)
requirements.pit_clock: ex/effective timestamps explicit; declared timestamps distinct from ex-dates
requirements.minimum_coverage: complete CA history (splits, cash dividends, special dividends, spin-offs, rights) for covered universe
requirements.rejection_condition: actions applied at pay date instead of ex-date; missing actions; ambiguous adjustment factors
requirements.evidence_needed_for_PASS: action ledger with ex/effective timestamps + golden spot-checks vs exchange announcements

requirements.pit_clock: announce_ts and effective_ts both exchange-timezone-aware, both with ingest timestamps
requirements.minimum_coverage: >= 8y of index maintenance events for F1 benchmark(s): every add/delete announced before effective
requirements.rejection_condition: announcement not distinguishable from effective; unversioned event stream; no ingest stamps
requirements.evidence_needed_for_PASS: provider maintenance-event archive with both timestamps + sample audit vs public announcements

requirements.pit_clock: universe snapshots contain accepted AND rejected/delisted members at each historical decision
requirements.rejection_condition: snapshots rebuilt from survivors; rejected rows missing
requirements.evidence_needed_for_PASS: snapshot diff vs frozen intake snapshots; rejected-row census

consuming_family_or_component: factory_shared (A3 data / A4 calendar+CA / A5 accounting-execution)
requirements.pit_clock: raw prices for fills; adjusted series declared with exact adjustment policy + factor provenance
requirements.minimum_coverage: full history both representations for covered universe
requirements.rejection_condition: adjustment policy implicit/undeclared; adjusted series used for fills or raw for total-return signals without declared transform
requirements.evidence_needed_for_PASS: round-trip reconciliation raw -> adjusted -> raw with frozen factors

consuming_family_or_component: factory_shared (A3 data / A4 calendar+CA / A5 accounting-execution)
requirements.pit_clock: exchange timestamps per print/bar; bid/ask or trade prints with executable semantics
requirements.minimum_coverage: daily OHLCV >= 8y; intraday/quotes where an arm's execution clock requires (>= 3y if scored)
requirements.rejection_condition: non-executable synthetic mid quotes without provenance; volume fields missing or unit-ambiguous
requirements.evidence_needed_for_PASS: schema with executable-price semantics + venue documentation
requirements.synthetic_fixture_exists: yes (A5 quote/execution goldens for semantics; real data absent)

consuming_family_or_component: factory_shared (A3 data / A4 calendar+CA / A5 accounting-execution)
requirements.pit_clock: benchmark series with dividends; PIT-consistent, no future restatement in scored window
requirements.minimum_coverage: SPY total-return + price index + dividend history covering full S0 window
requirements.rejection_condition: benchmark missing dividends; silently revised series
requirements.evidence_needed_for_PASS: benchmark manifest with checksums + policy note on restatements

requirements.pit_clock: availability effective-dated at decision timestamp; missing availability fails closed (short rejected)
requirements.minimum_coverage: daily availability for covered universe across S0
requirements.rejection_condition: free-borrow default; availability backfilled from current state
requirements.evidence_needed_for_PASS: locate log samples reconciling vs provider feed

requirements.pit_clock: fee/rate and utilization effective-dated daily; basis (360) declared; recalls policy documented
requirements.minimum_coverage: daily fee + utilization across S0 for covered universe
requirements.rejection_condition: fee applied with wrong accrual basis; utilization derived from non-PIT snapshot; recalls undocumented
requirements.evidence_needed_for_PASS: fee/utilization history + basis/recall documentation + golden spot-checks
requirements.synthetic_fixture_exists: yes (A5 borrow-fee accrual goldens for semantics; real data absent)

requirements.area: timestamps, timezone and exchange calendar conventions
consuming_family_or_component: factory_shared (A3 data / A4 calendar+CA / A5 accounting-execution)
requirements.pit_clock: exchange-timezone-aware stamps; session convention documented against official NYSE/Nasdaq calendar
requirements.minimum_coverage: all delivered series; reconciliation vs US_EQUITY_REGULAR_V1 for >= 10y incl. half-days
requirements.rejection_condition: naive timestamps; sessions contradicting the frozen calendar without declared reason
requirements.evidence_needed_for_PASS: calendar reconciliation report vs frozen US_EQUITY_REGULAR_V1 (digest 028a7b21...) plus NEEDS_PROVIDER_VERIFICATION closure

consuming_family_or_component: factory_shared (A3 data / A4 calendar+CA / A5 accounting-execution)
requirements.pit_clock: restatement policy explicit; scored windows pinned to a frozen snapshot/vintage
requirements.minimum_coverage: provider documents revision policy; snapshot immutability demonstrated

consuming_family_or_component: factory_shared (A3 data / A4 calendar+CA / A5 accounting-execution)
requirements.pit_clock: deterministic export; schema documented and versioned
requirements.minimum_coverage: format loadable by the as-built loader (parquet/csv) with declared schema version
requirements.evidence_needed_for_PASS: schema doc + deterministic-export test on two pulls

consuming_family_or_component: factory_shared (A3 data / A4 calendar+CA / A5 accounting-execution)
requirements.pit_clock: S0 floor: >= 8y daily across common eligible population; >= 30 eligible liquid names per decision; >= 3y intraday if intraday fills scored
requirements.minimum_coverage: full covered universe across S0 window
requirements.rejection_condition: floors unmet on loader-resolved values (not file presence)
requirements.evidence_needed_for_PASS: coverage census computed by the as-built loader/audit

consuming_family_or_component: factory_shared (A3 data / A4 calendar+CA / A5 accounting-execution)
requirements.pit_clock: sha256 per delivered file; manifest verified before load; snapshots append-only
requirements.rejection_condition: any file failing checksum; mutable delivery locations

requirements.area: license, storage, research-use and redistribution permissions
consuming_family_or_component: factory_shared (A3 data / A4 calendar+CA / A5 accounting-execution)
requirements.pit_clock: n/a (legal) — must be established before ingestion
requirements.minimum_coverage: written terms covering research use, storage location, retention, redistribution limits
requirements.rejection_condition: terms permit redistribution of licensed raw payloads into Git; research use unclear
requirements.evidence_needed_for_PASS: license text reviewed by owner; storage plan keeping payloads outside Git

consuming_family_or_component: factory_shared (A3 data / A4 calendar+CA / A5 accounting-execution)
requirements.pit_clock: gaps/corrections declared; loader fail-closed beyond declared tolerance
requirements.minimum_coverage: gap census + correction log for delivered history
requirements.rejection_condition: silent gap-filling; undisclosed corrections inside pinned windows
requirements.evidence_needed_for_PASS: written policy + gap census reconciling vs as-built audit
